hero.title: Taiwan: Taipei -> Hsinchu
hero.description: First time in Taiwan. Flights: 1,544.08 EUR (round trip, Economy Flex). Taipei, then a week in Hsinchu with day trips.

cards.title: Flight and arrival in Taipei
cards.description: Long journey via Munich and Bangkok (20h), landing Friday night. First night at the Alfar Hotel.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: Alfar Hotel (1 night, Aug 28 - 29)

sections.title: Thu Aug 27 - Outbound flight
items: LH 2323: Luxembourg (LUX) 8:10pm -> Munich (MUC) 9:15pm (Air Dolomiti)
LH 772: Munich 10:20pm -> Bangkok (BKK) 1:45pm (+1 day, A350-900)
LH 9728: Bangkok 5:15pm -> Taipei (TPE) 10:10pm (Thai Airways)
Total duration: 20h00 - arrival Terminal 1

sections.title: Fri Aug 28 - Arrival
items: Landing at Taoyuan (TPE) at 10:10pm, Terminal 1
Airport MRT to Taipei Main (~40 min, last departure ~11:35pm) or taxi (~45 min)
Check in at the Alfar Hotel, overnight

sections.title: Sat Aug 29 - Departure
items: Check out of the Alfar Hotel
Off to Taipei on the high-speed train (see the next stage)

cards.title: Taipei then Luodong - Turtle Island
cards.description: Morning in Taipei (Fu Hang Soy Milk and shopping), then the train to Luodong. Next day: Turtle Island, whales and island landing.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: CHECK inn HIVE, Luodong (2 nights, Aug 29 - 31) - booked

sections.title: Sat Aug 29 - Taipei then Luodong
items: High-speed train (THSR) to Taipei from Taoyuan

items.text: Breakfast at Fu Hang Soy Milk (local institution, go early for the queue)

items: Shopping around Taipei (Ximending, Zhongshan or Xinyi)

items.text: Train Taipei -> Luodong (~2h, east coast line)

items: Check in at CHECK inn HIVE (across from the station)

items.text: Luodong night market in the evening

sections.title: Sun Aug 30 - Turtle Island (booked)
items: Klook booking YVS176209 - 2 adults, 1:00pm departure

items.text: Meet at 12:20pm: Lanyang Museum Wushi Station, 1st floor (Huaqi 168), No. 60 Gangqian Road, Toucheng

items: Getting there from Luodong: 30 min to 1h (train to Toucheng then taxi, or taxi all the way)
Programme: whale watching, landing on the island and cruising around it (~4h)
Bring: passport (coast guard check), NTD 100/person cleaning fee on site, life jacket mandatory on board
The exact meeting time is confirmed the day before by 5pm (tides)

cards.title: Hsinchu - home base
cards.description: Six nights at the SOL Hotel (booked). A fixed base to explore the region on day trips and come back to Hsinchu every evening.

sections.title: Accommodation
items: SOL Hotel (6 nights, Aug 31 - Sep 6) - booked

sections.title: Mon Aug 31 - Jiufen, Taipei 101 and on to Hsinchu
items: Big day: check out in Luodong in the morning, sleep in Hsinchu. Jiufen sits right on the way.
Check out of CHECK inn HIVE, TRA Luodong -> Ruifang (~1h, east coast line)
Drop the bags in the lockers at Ruifang station (see the note below)

items.text: Bus 788 or 1062 Ruifang -> Jiufen (~15 min): Jiushi Old Street, tea houses and red lanterns

items: Back down to Ruifang early afternoon, pick up the bags
TRA Ruifang -> Taipei Main (~40 min)

items.text: Taipei 101: observatory for sunset (around 6:20pm in late August) - timed tickets to book ahead
Dinner at the Din Tai Fung inside Taipei 101 (level B1)

items: THSR Taipei -> Hsinchu HSR (~35 min) + shuttle, or TRA Taipei -> Hsinchu (~1h10)
Check in at the SOL Hotel late evening

sections.title: Tue Sep 1 - Taipei: Xinyi and the east side
items: THSR Hsinchu -> Taipei (~35 min), then MRT from Taipei Main

items.text: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall: the classic framing of Taipei 101, plus the changing of the guard
Xinyi district at the foot of Taipei 101: malls, Eslite, skywalks
Songshan Cultural and Creative Park: old tobacco factory turned design and exhibition space
Elephant Mountain (Xiangshan): 20 min of steps for the postcard view of Taipei 101 at sunset (~6:20pm)
Raohe Street night market and Ciyou Temple right beside it

items: Back to Hsinchu: check the time of the last THSR (~11pm)

sections.title: Wed Sep 2 - Taipei: old town and museums
items: THSR Hsinchu -> Taipei (~35 min)

items.text: National Palace Museum in the morning: the world's largest collection of Chinese art (allow 3h)
Chiang Kai-shek Memorial and the changing of the guard (hourly)
Longshan Temple, the finest temple in the city
Ximending: the youth district, shops and street food
Dadaocheng and Dihua Street at dusk: old trading houses, tea and herbal shops
Ningxia night market (small and very food-focused) or Shilin (the biggest)

sections.title: Thu Sep 3 - Neiwan and Hsinchu
items: A quieter day between three big Taipei days

items.text: TRA Neiwan line from Hsinchu (~1h, change at Zhuzhong)

items: Neiwan old street: Hakka specialties, rice cakes, covered market
Walk along the You-Luo river and the suspension bridge
Back to Hsinchu late afternoon

items.text: City God Temple (Cheng Huang) and its snack market - the best bihun in town
East Gate (Yingxi Gate) and the moat, 5 min on foot
Alternative: Beipu (lei cha) and Lion's Head Mountain by Hsinchu Bus 5700 / 5701

sections.title: Fri Sep 4 - Tamsui (Danshui)
items: THSR Hsinchu -> Taipei, then MRT red line to the Tamsui terminus (~40 min from Taipei Main)

items.text: Tamsui old street and the riverside promenade
Fort San Domingo (Hongmao Cheng): Spanish fort turned British consulate, with the Little White House next door
Aletheia University and its old Chinese-style campus
Ferry from Tamsui pier to Fisherman's Wharf (~10 min) and Lover's Bridge

items: Sunset over the strait from the wharf: this is THE reason to come to Tamsui
To try: a-gei (stuffed tofu, the local specialty), iron eggs, fish crackers, giant shaved ice

items.text: Option on the way back: Beitou hot springs, on the same red line

sections.title: Sat Sep 5 - Taichung day trip

items.text: THSR Hsinchu -> Taichung (~35 min)

items: National Taichung Theater (Toyo Ito architecture)
Miyahara: former clinic turned ice cream parlor and tea shop

items.text: Rainbow Village or the Calligraphy Greenway park

items: Fengjia night market if there's energy left

sections.title: Sun Sep 6 - Last morning
items: Check out of the SOL Hotel
Last shopping at the Cheng Huang temple market
Head to Taoyuan airport (see the next stage)

sections.title: Getting around
items: Downtown Hsinchu: all walkable from the SOL Hotel
City buses and YouBike for the coast and the park
Hsinchu Bus (terminal near the TRA station) for Beipu and Shitoushan
THSR for Taipei and Taichung: early bird tickets 28 days ahead (-10 to -35%)

sections.title: Local specialties
items: Bihun: rice vermicelli, Hsinchu's signature dish
Gong wan: pork meatball soup
Rou yuan: meatball wrapped in translucent dough

cards.title: Back to Luxembourg
cards.description: Last morning in Hsinchu, transfer to Taoyuan airport, then overnight flight via Bangkok and Munich.

sections.title: Transport
items: Hsinchu -> Taoyuan airport: THSR Hsinchu HSR -> Taoyuan HSR + airport MRT (~50 min), or direct bus/taxi (~45 min)
Be at Terminal 1 around 4:30pm (flight at 6:50pm)
LH 9729: Taipei (TPE) 6:50pm -> Bangkok (BKK) 9:35pm (Thai Airways, A350-900)
LH 773: Bangkok 10:55pm -> Munich (MUC) 5:15am (+1 day)
LH 2316: Munich 7:55am -> Luxembourg (LUX) 9:00am, Monday Sep 7
Total duration: 20h10

sections.title: To plan
items: Online check-in the day before
Check baggage allowance: 1 checked 23 kg + 1 cabin 8 kg
Bring entertainment: 2 layovers, overnight on the plane
